text.autoconfig.littlemaidrebirth.title: LittleMaid ReBirth Config
text.autoconfig.littlemaidrebirth.option: Enable Natural Spawn

When enabled, maids will spawn naturally.
Even if disabled, you can still meet maids by crafting spawn eggs.
Enable Despawn
When enabled, wild maids will despawn.
Spawn Biome Tags

Specifies biomes where maids naturally spawn using tags.
Direct biome ID specification is not supported.
Exclude Biome Tags

Specifies biomes where maids will NOT spawn using tags.
Direct biome ID specification is not supported.
Spawn Weight
Spawn weight for maids. Higher values make maids spawn more frequently.
Minimum Spawn Group Size
Minimum number of maids that spawn together in a single spawn event.
Maximum Spawn Group Size
Maximum number of maids that spawn together in a single spawn event.
Silent by Default

When enabled, wild maids spawn with silent voices.
This does not affect already spawned wild maids.
Default Sound Pack Name

Wild maids spawn with the specified sound pack.
This does not affect already spawned wild maids.
Specification must match exactly, and available sound packs can be checked from the sound pack list.
If no match is found, the specification is ignored.
Heal Interval

Interval at which maids consume salary to heal themselves.
Unit is ticks.
Heal Amount
Amount of health maids restore when consuming salary to heal themselves.
Heal Delay Threshold
Health threshold for delaying healing to prevent action cancellation.
Disable Maid Death

When enabled, maids will not die.
They still take damage, so salary will be consumed for healing.
General Maid Damage Factor
Damage taken by maids is multiplied by this factor.
Battle Mode Maid Damage Factor
Damage taken by battle mode maids is multiplied by this factor.
Non-Battle Mode Maid Damage Factor
Damage taken by non-battle mode maids is multiplied by this factor.
Emergency Health Threshold

Maids enter emergency state when health falls below this threshold.
Unit is percentage, where 1 = 100%, 0.5 = 50%.
Work in Emergency

When enabled, maids in emergency state will continue working normally.
It's dangerous, so please let them rest.
Enable Friendly Fire
When enabled, friendly attacks will hit maids.
Enable Safe Movement
When enabled, maids will avoid dangerous blocks and high falls.
Immortal Maids

When enabled, maids take no damage whatsoever. They are invincible.
Except for void damage and creative mode.
Fall Damage Immunity
When enabled, maids become immune to fall damage.
Non-Mob Damage Immunity
When enabled, maids will not take damage from non-mob sources.
Freedom Mode Speed
Movement speed of maids in freedom mode.
Freedom Mode Range

Range in which maids move in freedom mode.
Range is circular, with the specified value as the radius.
Tracer Mode Speed
Movement speed of maids in tracer mode.
Tracer Horizontal Range

Horizontal range for maids to track redstone in tracer mode.
Range is square, with ± the specified value as the range.
Tracer Vertical Range

Vertical range for maids to track redstone in tracer mode.
Range is square, with ± the specified value as the range.
Follow Mode Speed
Movement speed of maids in follow mode.
Follow Start Distance
Distance at which maids start following in follow mode.
Follow End Distance
Distance at which maids stop following in follow mode.
Sprint Speed
Sprint movement speed of maids in follow mode.
Sprint Start Distance
Distance at which maids start sprinting in follow mode.
Sprint End Distance
Distance at which maids stop sprinting in follow mode.
Teleport Start Distance
Distance at which maids start teleporting in follow mode.
Emergency Teleport Start Distance
Distance at which maids in emergency state start teleporting.
Teleport Range Width

Width of teleport destination range centered on the master.
If set to 3, maids will teleport within a -3 to 3 range.
Teleport Range Height

Height of teleport destination range centered on the master.
If set to 1, maids will teleport within a -1 to 1 range.
Can Teleport to Owner's Front

When enabled, maids can teleport to the front of the owner.
This might be a little annoying.
Owner Forward Range

Range in front of the owner.
Range is square, with the specified value as one side.
Max Teleport Attempts
Maximum number of teleport attempts per tick.
Item Pickup Speed
Movement speed when maids go to pick up items.
Item Pickup Range

Range in which maids go to pick up items.
Range is circular, with the specified value as the radius.
Item Pickup Frequency

Frequency at which maids go to pick up items.
If set to 40, they will execute once every 40 ticks.
Escape Speed
Movement speed when wild maids are fleeing.
Default Work Item Slot Size

Default number of work item slots.
Individual settings can be configured from the maid inventory.
Max Target Range
Maximum distance to target mobs.
Fencer Attack Distance Factor
Fencer attack distance is multiplied by this factor.
Fencer Attack Rate Factor
Fencer attack rate is multiplied by this factor.
Archer Shoot Distance Factor

Archer shooting distance is multiplied by this factor.
By the way, maids try to maintain between 100% and 75% of their shooting distance.
Archer Shoot Rate Factor
Archer shooting rate is multiplied by this factor.
Archer Shoot Velocity Factor

Archer shooting velocity is multiplied by this factor.
By the way, arrow damage increases with velocity.
Torcher Light Level Threshold

Light level threshold for torcher to place lights.
Lights are placed in areas with light level below this threshold.
Container Search Range

Range to search for containers when storing items.
Range is circular, with the specified value as the radius.
Salary Consumption Interval

Interval at which salary is consumed.
Unit is ticks.
Unpaid Days Limit

Maximum number of days maids will tolerate unpaid salary.
If exceeded, they will go on strike. Prepare some cake.
Max Auto Salary Receipt Slot Size

Maximum slot size for auto salary receipt.
If set to 3, maids will try to receive up to 3 stacks of salary.
Auto Salary Receipt Start Threshold

Salary slot threshold to start auto salary receipt.
If set to 1, maids will try to receive salary when they have 1 slot or less.
Max Memory Salary Box Count

Number of salary box positions that can be memorized.
Note: Empty salary boxes are ignored.
Salary Box Memory Distance
Distance for memorizing salary boxes.
Salary Box Memory Interval
Interval for memorizing salary boxes.
Salary Box Search Distance

Distance to search for salary boxes.
Note: The distance for maids to memorize salary boxes is set separately.
Auto Salary Receipt Start Interval
Interval to start receiving salary from salary boxes.
Auto Salary Receipt Path Finding Interval
Interval for pathfinding to salary boxes.
Max Move Time for Auto Salary Receipt

Maximum time that can be spent moving to a salary box.
If it takes longer, they will give up.
Max Move Time After Auto Salary Receipt

Maximum time that can be spent returning to waiting position.
If it takes longer, they will give up.
Can Pickup Items
When enabled, maids can pick up items.
Can Pickup Experience Orbs
When enabled, maids can pick up experience orbs.
Wild Maids Can Pickup Items

When enabled, wild maids can pick up items.
Items picked up by wild maids cannot be retrieved unless you defeat them or hire them.
Maid Milking Feature

When enabled, you can get milk from maids.

...Pervert! Weirdo! Inhuman!
Voice Interval

Interval at which maids make sounds.
They will only make a sound once during the specified interval.
Unit is ticks.
Salary Stare Range
Range in which maids look at you when you hold salary.
Salary Follow Range
Range in which maids follow you when you hold salary.
Cake Stare Range
Range in which maids look at you when you hold cake.
Cake Follow Range
Range in which maids follow you when you hold cake.
Max Acceleration Stacks
Maximum number consumed during gunpowder acceleration.
Acceleration Ticks Per Stack
Length of acceleration ticks per gunpowder.
Acceleration Multiplier
Tick multiplier during acceleration.
Alert Range
Range in which maids detect targets and perform preemptive attacks.
Combat Range
Range in which maids actually perform combat actions.
Dangerous Target Avoid Distance
Distance to keep from dangerous targets like Creepers when avoiding them.
Distribution Targeting Ratio

Ratio of maids that attack the same target to prevent concentrated attacks.
50% of maids will attack the same target.
Max Attackers Per Target

Maximum number of maids that can simultaneously attack one target.
Prevents concentrated attacks.
Injured Health Threshold

Health threshold at which maids are considered injured.
Maids with 50% or less health are considered injured.
Attacked By Valid Ticks
Number of ticks during which an attack is considered valid for targeting decisions.
Enable Wait Pose While Moving
When enabled, maids maintain their wait pose even when moved while waiting.
